authority_scope: L4 ARM observed business response; not a formal ontology event family
stationary_tolerance_basis: Raw velocities are serialized to six decimal places; this threshold accepts recorded zero, not operationally slow driving.

geometric_thresholds.low_altitude_basis: The low-altitude descent profile is authored as 30 -> 15 -> 5 m; 20 m separates the low-altitude leg from the transit altitude without reading the script's own descent stage.
geometric_thresholds.pedestrian_near_basis: Source pedestrian_near_miss trigger horizontal_distance_m/vertical_distance_m; both conditions must hold on the measured separation.
geometric_thresholds.landing_zone_basis: Governed landing_zone_radius_m from the core predicate registry, centred on the source descent target until an actual replacement descent is dispatched; not a birth pad or a declared facility.
geometric_thresholds.contact_basis: Identical to the authored vehicle_roof_contact trigger distance (3.0 m, 3D). Damage may only be read as evidence after the same measured geometry that authorises the response has held.
geometric_thresholds.stationary_basis: Same recorded-zero threshold as stationary_speed_tolerance_mps; a physically stopped vehicle is one whose measured speed is recorded zero.
geometric_thresholds.airborne_basis: Governed airborne_threshold_m from the core predicate registry.
geometric_thresholds.touchdown_basis: Governed touchdown_threshold_m from the core predicate registry.
geometric_thresholds.min_yield_center_separation_basis: Authored PRIORITY_VEHICLE_MIN_CENTER_SEPARATION_M: the priority and yield lanes are physically distinct at this centre separation.
geometric_thresholds.hold_creep_basis: A holding aircraft may drift only with sensor noise; 0.05 m/s is far below any authored transit speed and far above the six-decimal velocity rounding floor.

definitions.near_pair: Euclidean distance and continuous dwell taken from the source vehicle_collision_warning trigger.
definitions.braking_active: Both bound vehicles have vehicle_state.braking == true.
definitions.yielding_active: At least one bound vehicle has vehicle_state.yielding == true.
definitions.braking_stopped: Both vehicles report braking and have observed speed <= stationary_speed_tolerance_mps.
definitions.ambulance_approaching_vehicle: Source civilian_vehicle_yields distance predicate and dwell hold, and the ambulance-to-civilian relative range rate is closing; the measured approach geometry, reported separately from the request state.
definitions.priority_request_active: The source ambulance_priority_approach move action actually dispatched successfully and the next state sample is observed. The request stays active from the dispatch onward until the passage completes; it does not require the ambulance to still be closing, so a vehicle waiting for a clearance keeps its request active. Cancelled or overwritten stationary approach movement does not activate it.
definitions.priority_request_acknowledged: Raw vehicle_state.priority_request_acknowledged; records the scheduled response handshake only. It carries no passage meaning and may hold before any geometric passage.
definitions.yield_clearance_satisfied: Measured lateral separation between the ambulance and the civilian exceeds the authored minimum lane-centre separation while the civilian is yielding; geometry only, not legal right of way.
definitions.ambulance_geometry_passed: Ambulance is downstream of the civilian along the fixed first nonzero authored ambulance approach segment; geometric order only, not legal right of way.
definitions.priority_passage_completed: ambulance_geometry_passed is true and a valid yield clearance was actually established during this passage; the clearance is carried as passage history, so a civilian that has already finished yielding does not erase the completion. Never true before the geometric crossing.
definitions.uav_low_altitude: Measured UAV height above local ground is below the governed low-altitude band; from trajectories, not from a declared state.
definitions.aircraft_near_pedestrian: Measured horizontal and vertical UAV-to-pedestrian separation both fall inside the source pedestrian_near_miss proximity thresholds; the pre-existing formal safety.aircraft_near_pedestrian margin is not reused as this local geometry.
definitions.landing_zone_occupied: A bound pedestrian is inside the landing-zone radius around the source low-descent destination. After the first successfully dispatched descent at or after the fork, use that executed move's destination; the dispatch sample retains the common source target. The centre stays fixed during flight and later return-home movement.
definitions.pedestrian_clear_of_landing_zone: Every bound pedestrian is outside the fixed current descent-target radius; the complement of landing_zone_occupied under the same measurement.
definitions.uav_hold_active: Raw control_state.hold_active together with measured horizontal speed at or below hold_creep_speed_mps; the aircraft must actually hold position, not merely declare an intent.
definitions.uav_landed: Measured height at or below the governed touchdown threshold together with speed at or below the stationary threshold; a physical touchdown, not the declared post_activity_type.
definitions.uav_vehicle_proximity: Measured 3D UAV-to-ground-vehicle separation is at or below the authored vehicle_roof_contact trigger distance (3.0 m); the current-tick approach band.
definitions.uav_vehicle_contact: The authored trigger geometry has held at least once during this window (history, so a later separation does not erase it); contact is an event that happened, not a state that must persist.
definitions.uav_damaged: Measured contact has held at least once during this window together with raw incident_state.physical_fault_active; damage without prior measured contact is a response running ahead of its cause and is reported false.
definitions.uav_airborne: Measured height above the governed airborne threshold; read from position, so a terminated aircraft reads false even if a later script schedules it to fly.
definitions.vehicle_emergency_stop_active: Raw vehicle_state.emergency_stop; the declared response only.
definitions.vehicle_physically_stopped: Measured speed <= stationary_speed_tolerance_mps; a physically stopped vehicle is one whose recorded velocity is zero, independent of any declared emergency stop.
definitions.minimal_risk_maneuver: Raw sensor_fault and minimal_risk_maneuver_active are true.
definitions.declared_stopped_safe: Raw vehicle_state.stopped_safe, materialized by the L4 engine only when the actual MRM response move has finished at its endpoint without interruption. It is not an advance command acknowledgement; the physical predicate independently requires recorded zero speed.
definitions.physically_stopped_safe: Raw sensor_fault, minimal_risk_maneuver_active, stopped_safe are true and observed speed <= stationary_speed_tolerance_mps.

event_policy.onset: One occurrence per authored incident instance; the priority-passage instance requires the actual priority-approach movement dispatch and a measured closing approach. Pure geometry remains independent and may be true during earlier background entry. The pedestrian and UAV-vehicle instances open on the measured geometric contact or near-pedestrian predicate, never on a declared flag.
event_policy.terminal: Terminal predicate true on two consecutive formal samples after onset; record the confirmed local outcome, never infer global hazard recovery, legal right of way, or clinical recovery.
event_policy.missing: Inactive lifecycle samples are unknown; absent required typed state fields are explicit errors.
event_policy.causality: Predicate and event-phase evidence only; no causal edge inferred from temporal order.
